SongComments.SongComment: In this very small tutorial, we show one usage of the delay column.
The delay column is hidden by default. Click the DLY button on the lower toolbar, or press LCTRL+LSHIRT+D on a track to show it.
This column lets you define a delay in the triggering of a note. Values range from 00 (no delay) to FF (almost a row of delay), so 80 is one half of a row, 40 is 1/4, C0 is 3/4, and so on.
Look how in this pattern, we use the delay column to create a guitar arpeggio in a quite self-explanatory way. Firstly, there is a non-delayed chord, then the arpeggio comes.
